title: Buds Station Collab Look
request: Oct 19 2026 9:37 ICT: Max asked directly: 'please add more decks for powerhaus and buds station. but please create new designs that still have our brand but have more differences than our roselle line.' Each partner gets its own co-branded sub-line look (containers, label shapes, patterns, palettes, type, in-studio / in-shop, menu, merch).
example_data: Drawn SVG mockups of a Buds Station Lounge sub-line: round tins, jars, pillow packs, lounge scenes, menu and merch in pink, butter and powder blue with clouds and a sleepy cat. No plant shapes, no religious imagery (build check); The Buds Station set in type only. No prices or claims.
no_cap: Max approved no 10-pick cap for the collab decks (Oct 18 2026)
built_at_note: WellNest collab look decks, Oct 19 2026 9:37 ICT request
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind); brand colours only inside the mockups
WellNest DNA: circle + script mark, cream, mono small print, kraft cue; not the Roselle cream-label kraft pouch
